news_risk: No adverse media, regulator action or negative news found. Searches for the company name returned no news items; the only public record trail is tax litigation (see court_cases) and a Global Energy Ownership Tracker entry in OpenSanctions. Note: the general web-search backend (SearX) was unreachable during this check and Bing returned unusable results, so news coverage could not be exhaustively screened — treat news_risk as 'not found', not as 'verified clean'.
rf_supply: No evidence found. Indian Kanoon full-text search for "Saini Alloys" combined with "Russia" returned zero matching documents (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Saini%20Alloys%22%20Russia). No customs, B-L, contract or media record of supplies to Russia or CIS located. Status: no traces found; absence of evidence, not confirmed absence of trade.
note: Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List designation found. OpenSanctions (data current 2026-11-26) returns exactly one record for 'Saini Alloys' — a Company in India sourced from the Global Energy Ownership Tracker, which is an ownership dataset, NOT a sanctions list; no sanctions-programme match. The OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is a JS form and could not be queried via GET; the SDN CSV download was truncated in retrieval, so the OFAC negative is based on OpenSanctions aggregation plus absence of any designation reference in court/news records — recommend a direct OFAC/EU/UK consolidated-list re-screen before contracting. Court cases: all identified litigation is tax (income-tax faceless assessment, GST/state tax, central excise/service tax) or a long-running electricity-dues dispute with U.P. Power Corporation; the company appears consistently as petitioner/appellant, i.e. it is the one challenging assessments, not a defendant in fraud or criminal proceedings. No criminal case against the company or its directors was found. Per project rule 2, these matters are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action or rating found in public sources; not public as far as could be determined. Note the name ambiguity: the batch lists both 'Saini Alloys Private Limited' and 'Saini Alloys Limited' (and the claimed legal name 'SAINI ALLOYS LIMITED'); the court record shows both entities exist and litigate separately (Allahabad HC 2022/2023 matters and Delhi HC 2026 matter are the Pvt Ltd; Allahabad HC Writ Tax 1293/2023 is the Limited). Risk findings above are attributed to the name group as a whole; legal-identity resolution is outside this role's scope. No legal identity, HS code or shipment-volume research was performed, per role scope.
